title: unit
description: A systemd unit file in /etc/systemd/system, mode 0644 root:root, followed by systemctl daemon-reload (D-260). Key: name. Timers, sockets and so on are units too. The unit is not enabled or started here: use a service resource with the same name (restart_on: [unit:<name>]). Risk: create and change reversible, delete destructive. Kinds: vm, lxc.

name.description: Unit file name with its suffix. plumb-agent.* is refused: the agent unit belongs to Plumb.

content.description: Full content of the unit file. Required when state is present.
